resources.string: Copy progress between the phone and a computer.
The computer’s clipboard changed and it could not supply the previous file. Copy the file again.
Windows could not supply the file. Copy it again. If the clipboard still does not respond, reconnect to this computer.
This PC does not support clipboard transfer of files of 4 GiB or larger. Copy this file through the Phone drive.
The file manager shared only part of the selection. Copy a folder or select fewer files at a time.
